BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain blocksworld-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)

  (:predicates
    (on ?top ?bottom)
    (on-table ?block)
    (clear ?block)
    (holding ?block)
    (arm-empty)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?block)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?block) (clear ?block) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?block)
      (not (on-table ?block))
      (not (clear ?block))
      (not (arm-empty)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?block)
    :precondition (holding ?block)
    :effect (and
      (on-table ?block)
      (clear ?block)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?block)))
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?top ?bottom)
    :precondition (and (holding ?top) (clear ?bottom))
    :effect (and
      (on ?top ?bottom)
      (clear ?top)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?top))
      (not (clear ?bottom)))
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?top ?bottom)
    :precondition (and (on ?top ?bottom) (clear ?top) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?top)
      (clear ?bottom)
      (not (on ?top ?bottom))
      (not (clear ?top))
      (not (arm-empty)))
  )
)
END DOMAIN
